_overview: Legend only: Bob ignores this key. Comments are NOT allowed anywhere else in this file (plain JSON.parse; strict schema under "hooks" -- an invalid file silently disables ALL hooks). Validate with: jq . .bob/settings.json
SessionStart      preflight.sh        print env warnings (Java, Docker, buildx) into context
UserPromptSubmit  record-prompt.sh    journal the prompt (silent, receipt only)
PreToolUse  *     relay-pending.sh    block next call ONCE if check-edit found failures
PreToolUse  exec  gate-commit.sh      block `git commit` while pytest or mvn test is red
PostToolUse *     record-tool.sh      journal every tool call (feeds the receipt)
PostToolUse edit  check-edit.sh       per-service checks: mypy+pytest / tsc+eslint / mvn test-compile
Stop              session-receipt.sh  write state/receipts/<time>_<session>.txt per turn: timeline + hooks fired
